# Bundled XLSX parser

`xlsx.full.min.js` is the browser distribution from `@e965/xlsx` 0.20.3, Apache 2.0. The distribution was obtained from the npm package `@e965/xlsx/-/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` and is loaded only as a local classic script. SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`.

See `XLSX-LICENSE.txt` for the bundled license. The app never loads a parser from a CDN.
